name: Four Seasons Hotel Hong Kong
positioning: Contemporary hotel in the IFC complex in Central, Hong Kong, connected to the ifc Shopping Mall and the Hong Kong MTR Station, with Michelin-starred restaurants
best_for: Travelers who want a hotel connected to the IFC mall and the Hong Kong MTR Station
Diners drawn to Michelin-starred restaurants such as Lung King Heen and Caprice

facts.text: The hotel is at 8 Finance Street, Central, Hong Kong.
The hotel is part of the International Finance Centre (IFC) complex in the heart of the city's Central district.
The hotel is connected to the ifc Shopping Mall.
The hotel has a direct link to the Hong Kong MTR Station.
The Airport Express train takes just 24 minutes between the airport and Central.
The hotel has 399 rooms in total.
The hotel's design is contemporary, with modern art and Asian accents.
Lung King Heen is the first Chinese restaurant in the world to earn 3 Michelin Stars.
Caprice, the hotel's French restaurant, has three Michelin stars.
The Fitness Centre is open 24 hours.
Condé Nast Traveler says the guest rooms and suites had a major renovation from 2020 to 2022.

highlights.text: Floor-to-ceiling windows offer sweeping views of Victoria Harbour and city skyline.
The Spa has wall-to-wall windows with sweeping views of Victoria Harbour and the city skyline.
The infinity pool appears to spill over the infinity edge off the sixth-floor roof deck and into Victoria Harbour.
ARGO, the hotel's cocktail bar, is named one of World's Best Bars.
Superior Harbour-View Suites have only one unit per floor.

considerations.text: Condé Nast Traveler says navigating the IFC maze to reach the Airport Express can be confusing on your first visit.
The escalator from IFC Mall to the hotel is temporarily closed for maintenance from September 1 to November 30, 2026, so guests use the lift next to the Audemars Piguet Boutique.
WhataHotel notes the hotel is in the busy Central district with heavy foot traffic.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
